sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: Leucaena is a shrub or small tree native to Mexico and Central America, now planted in tropical regions. Its height varies considerably, from about 0.6 to 9 m.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and pods
sections.text: The leaves are bipinnate. Cream flower heads about 2 cm across produce flat pods 8–18 cm long and 1.4–2.1 cm wide.

sections.title: Uses and toxicity
sections.text: Young leaves and pods are eaten as a vegetable in some cuisines, but the plant contains mimosine. Large intakes can poison animals; this use does not establish a safe preparation or amount for people.
